about_the_game:
Delivery Days

In Delivery Days, you play as WHF salaryman,  stuck in the daily grind of remote work, emails, and existential dread. His only joy? The doorbell that rings every afternoon — bringing food, and other stuff.

But one day, something changes.
Instead of the usual delivery guy, a beautiful woman stands at the door. She's kind, charming, and completely out of his league... probably. Suddenly, lunch isn't just about food — it's about fate.

  • Genre: Visual Novel + Dating Sim

  • Setting: MC's room

  • Main Role: Salary man

  • Core Loop:

    • Order through app so ladies can delivary 

    • Choose correct dialogue to trigger Scenes

    • Manage work performance to unlock story events

  • Romance Paths:

    • Build trust with characters through work, events, and dates

    • Three main romance routes, each with their own tone and twists

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
